name: breakthrough
description: Connects your AI assistant to a living playbook distilled from your team's sales calls, so it knows what works across your organization and the next move on every deal, without you having to manage any of it.

interface.shortDescription: Your sales playbook, wherever you work.
interface.longDescription: Connects your assistant to a living playbook distilled from your sales calls, so it drafts and answers with the context and the approach that actually works across your organization. Reads contacts, companies, call transcripts and your playbook from your own Breakthrough organization.
defaultPrompt: Prep me for my next call using our playbook
Give me a review of how this deal is progressing and my blind spots
How do I handle the objection from my last call?
